components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single action color. Used for Publish, Follow, and Use identity.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent); color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); border-color: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral action for retry, dismiss, unfollow, and cancel.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--faint); background: var(--hover); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The left-rail active state. A wash pill, never a left stripe.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent-ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item svg { flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Identity and follow fields. White on light, graphite on dark sheets.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; width: 240px; } .ds-field span { color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 38px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 10px; outline: none; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 13px; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft); }

components.name: Live Rate Pill
components.description: The compact health reading in the top bar and feed header.
components.css: .ds-live-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--accent-line); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ok); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--ok-soft); } .ds-live-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Wayposts Lab has two columns with different jobs. The center is a working social feed on white: read, post, like, follow, and switch identity. The right column is graphite and holds live measurements: req/s, p95, errors, in-flight requests, timeline reads, writes, and likes. A visitor can use the feed and, without leaving it, see the same work measured. The interface rejects SaaS purple glow, corporate blue dashboards, Matrix terminals, and AI landing pages.
keyCharacteristics: Three-column social shell: navigation, feed, instrument rail.
Hairlines instead of cards; one white feed against one graphite rail.
One accent, Signal Vermilion, used for action and selection only.
Archivo for the product; IBM Plex Mono for machine data only.
Flat at rest; depth comes from material and modal backdrop.
Real telemetry, useful empty states, complete error and loading coverage.
English and Brazilian Portuguese, persisted per visitor.

rules.name: The Two Materials Rule
rules.body: The feed is white. The instrument is graphite. They never overlap, blend, or borrow each other's text colors.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Vermilion covers less than 10% of any view. It marks action, not decoration.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: No gradients on text, no colored glows, no glassmorphism, no decorative shadow.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Machine Rule
rules.body: If a human wrote it, it is Archivo. If the system measured it, identified it, or produced it, it is IBM Plex Mono. Mono never appears in a heading, button, or paragraph.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: If two regions need separation, draw a 1px line. Do not reach for a card, a shadow, or a darker panel unless the region is the instrument rail itself.

rules.name: The Top-Layer Rule
rules.body: Only true modal surfaces get to float. Everything else stays in the document flow.

dos: Do keep the feed white and the instrument rail graphite.
Do separate feed items with 1px hairlines, not cards.
Do use Signal Vermilion for action and selection, under 10% of any view.
Do set metrics, IDs, timestamps, and commands in IBM Plex Mono.
Do read real data from /metrics and name the start command when idle.
Do pair every status dot with a text label.
Do use 12 to 16px panel radii and pill buttons.
donts: Don't use SaaS purple with glow.
Don't build a corporate blue dashboard.
Don't build an AI landing page.
Don't pair a 1px border with a wide decorative shadow.
Don't use card radii above 16px or nested cards.
Don't use colored side stripes, gradient text, glassmorphism, or striped backgrounds.
Don't invent traffic, fake a p95, or use mono for prose.
